name: C2PA Rust SDK
summary: Rust implementation of the C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) standard: embeds and verifies cryptographically signed manifests recording an asset's source and edit history.

name: MarkLLM
summary: Open-source toolkit implementing multiple LLM text watermarking algorithms (embedding and detection), including several designed for robustness against paraphrasing/removal attacks.

name: DeepfakeBench
summary: Comprehensive benchmark suite for deepfake detection: unified data processing, training/evaluation of 15+ detector models, and standardized evaluation protocols. Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial, not OSI-approved open source) -- flagged for review, not a standard permissive/copyleft license.

name: DeepSafe
summary: Modular, self-hostable platform that runs an ensemble of deepfake detection models (image/video/audio) behind a single API gateway, fusing their outputs via voting/averaging/stacking.

name: AI Text Detector (ai-detector-skill)
summary: Local, offline CLI/Python tool that scores text for AI-generated-writing signals using explainable weighted heuristics rather than an opaque model, deliberately conservative on short text.

name: ScanCode Toolkit
summary: Scans source trees and packages to detect declared/actual licenses, copyrights, and (now also) known vulnerabilities in code and dependencies; usable as a CLI or a library.
